paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 19:7 [the supplied text has ב״ק].[^1]

notes.text: The supplied locator is ב״ק פ״יט־ז. Reading it as Bereshit Rabbah 19:7 is an editorial inference: Bava Kamma has no chapter 19, and the stored Midrash Rabbah — TE scalar at 19:7 explicitly names Rabbi Chalfon. That exact passage supports Rabbi for this inferred occurrence; it does not prove the printed letters, silently correct Hyman, or establish a universal identity.
